source.title: Feliks Zemdegs wins Asian Championship 2010
source.content:
[Feliks Zemdegs](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2009ZEMD01) won the [Asian Championship 2010](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=AsianChampionship2010) with an average of 9.43 seconds. [Yumu Tabuchi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2006TABU02) finished second (10.98) and [Arifumi Fushimi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2009FUSH01) finished third (11.19).  
 World records: Feliks Zemdegs 4x4 Cube 34.41 (single), 2x2 Cube 2.35 (average).  
 Asian records: Yumu Tabuchi Rubik's Cube 9.82 (average), Arifumi Fushimi 3x3 with feet 49.33 (average).  
 Oceanic records: Feliks Zemdegs 4x4 Cube 41.71 (average), 2x2 Cube 1.13 (single), 3x3 one-handed 12.46 (single), 3x3 fewest moves 32 (single), Megaminx 56.90 (single) 1:13.74 (average), Rubik's Clock 10.02 (single), 7x7 Cube 3:57.53 (single) 4:05.35 (average).

translation.title: Feliks Zemdegs 夺得 2010 年亚洲锦标赛冠军
translation.content:
[Feliks Zemdegs](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2009ZEMD01)以 9.43 秒的平均成绩夺得 [2010 年亚洲锦标赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=AsianChampionship2010)冠军。[Yumu Tabuchi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2006TABU02)以 10.98 秒获得亚军，[Arifumi Fushimi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2009FUSH01)以 11.19 秒获得季军。

**世界纪录：**Feliks Zemdegs：四阶单次 34.41、二阶平均 2.35。

**亚洲纪录：**Yumu Tabuchi：三阶平均 9.82；Arifumi Fushimi：三阶脚拧平均 49.33。

**大洋洲纪录：**Feliks Zemdegs：四阶平均 41.71、二阶单次 1.13、三阶单手单次 12.46、三阶最少步单次 32，五魔方单次 56.90、平均 1:13.74，魔表单次 10.02，七阶单次 3:57.53、平均 4:05.35。
